option_relations.rationale: Solar retinopathy is a specific type of photic maculopathy caused by solar radiation, not LED light exposure.

The option 'Photic maculopathy derived from LED light exposure' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Phototoxic Maculopathy due to LED light exposure'. Both describe the same condition caused by the same etiology.
Photic Retinopathy is a broader category that includes phototoxic maculopathy due to LED light exposure. The option is a supertype of the leaf.
Photoretinitis (Light-Induced Retinopathy) is a broader category that includes phototoxic maculopathy due to LED light exposure. The option is a supertype of the leaf.
